g.text: Loss vs wall-clock: FP8 reaches each loss sooner

Held-out validation: fixed 2% of FineWeb-Edu documents, every 100 iterations (327k tokens). Panel A offsets the two arms' validation markers by ±8 iterations so they do not hide each other. Wall-clock = training
time only (startup and evaluation excluded). Loss above 8 (first ~60 iterations) is clipped.
Megatron-LM 1.28B on one Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201), FineWeb-Edu, 1000 iterations × 16k tokens
